faq.a: Aasma is associated with the Arabic form أسماء, whose core sense is heaven, sky, celestial realm.

faq.q: What is the origin of Aasma?
faq.a: Aasma is associated with Arabic. أسماء is the plural of اسم ('name') and also relates to سمو ('elevation'). Associated with Asmāʾ bint Abī Bakr in the sīra tradition.
Yes — the underlying form أسماء is Arabic.
Aasma can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
